info.title: playnet gateway doors
info.description: Every door the browser may call, declared once in module/playnet/doors/protocol.scm and emitted here, grouped by topic. The HTTP door (POST /api/{object}/{name}) carries the same doors CapTP does; a call is signed with an enrolled device key (RFC 9421) unless the door is anonymous. The same doors are MCP tools: POST /api/mcp speaks JSON-RPC (initialize, tools/list, tools/call), and browser/api/mcp-tools.json is the committed tool list. Doors a client cannot reach (root tier, operator) are listed under x-playnet-doors.

post.summary: Registers a seat for an AID whose OOBI is hosted elsewhere: resolves it through KERIA, persists the member, and replies ok or (error reason). Use signup-with-icp when the browser holds its own KEL.

x-playnet-doors.name: enroll-device
x-playnet-doors.summary: Records a device authorization WIRE-JSON signed by this AID's root key after verifying it against the current KEL key; replies ok or an error, and refuses a device-tier session.

x-playnet-doors.name: forget-me
x-playnet-doors.summary: Erases every record of this gateway's own keyed by this AID — bindings, push subscriptions, contact points, devices, cards, user files, mailboxes, spooled mail — and last the member record and AID-to-handle index, leaving the key log as data about a pseudonym; replies the receipt (what went, by kind and count, and what stays), refuses a device-tier session, and this session cap refuses everything from then on.

x-playnet-doors.name: rotate-aid
x-playnet-doors.summary: Verifies rotation event ROT-ALIST-RAW with SIGS against this AID's key state and appends it to the oobi-host KEL; replies ok or an error, and refuses a device-tier session.
